target_avatars.relevance: Frances discusses team dynamics and how to leverage the strengths of individual team members.

episode_summary: Frances Katzen shares her insights on the importance of having a strong opinion in real estate, the impact of the Pietta Tear Tax on the New York market, and how her ballet background instilled discipline and resilience. She emphasizes the value of media appearances for personal branding and provides actionable advice on creating effective marketing materials.
